description:
One call to a working, routed form
Creates (idempotently, by name within project) the project if missing, the form, a destination for whichever of notify_email/telegram/webhook was given, and a direct route, then returns the form, an embeddable snippet, a curl command to verify delivery, and next steps. Everything it does is also available as individual calls (POST /v1/forms, /v1/destinations, /v1/routes); this is a convenience, not a special path.
name: quickstart
